data.description:
New

  • Sell from backpack, rig and pockets — sell loot without moving it to the stash first. On by default.
  • Sell from secure container — off by default.

Both are in the F12 menu under Selling.

Fixed

  • The keybinds used a separate copy of the location check from the context menu, so the two could disagree. Both now use the same one.
  • Removed the old UI Fixes dependency GUID, which was producing a warning in the log on every launch.

Changed

  • One sell sound per batch. Selling many items at once played the confirmation sound for every item. It now plays once for the whole sale.

Thanks to Elmer-Glue for the fix in #2.

QuickSell v4.0.1 — changes since v3.4.0

  • Trader prices include attachments. QuickSell’s trader tooltip and sale confirmation now account for attached weapon parts. Prices recalculate when attachments or stack counts change.
  • Flea prices include attachments, including nested parts, in tooltips and sale confirmations.
  • New F12 setting: Allow flea market selling. Turning it off blocks both QuickSell flea sales and listings from the normal flea page. Flea buying remains available.
  • New flea price refresh hotkey. You can assign a key in F12 to trigger the existing manual refresh.
  • New sell sound option. Choose whether the sound plays once per batch or once for each item sold.
  • Fixed QuickSell price tooltips appearing on trader-owned items and causing console overflow errors.

Installation: Extract the ZIP into your SPT root folder.

Requires SPT 4.1.3.

QuickSell v4.2.0

  • Optimized price tooltips to eliminate lag and stutter.
  • Improved performance for backpacks, containers and nested items.
  • Improved price cache updates when moving items.
  • Added extra stability fixes.
